Question: Do you have a list of the people served by your Center?
Answer: Yes
Observation: You will have to get a use permit for a Community Center. A private individual isn't allowed to run a community center. There is some question as to whether City would allow use in a residential area.
On December 19, 1977 the Steering Committee met to further discuss and consider the staff and citizen proposals for CDBG projects. The final result of the meeting was the adoption of a preliminary plan which was then referred to the planning area committees for study. In this meeting the Steering Committee questioned city staff concerning certain proposals, then took a vote on what specific projects to include in each target area. Portions of the Committee questioning and voting is included below for certain proposals.
Redevelopment Agency Budget (a) Considerable community interest, especially within the Steering Committee, focused on the CDBG funds proposed for the Redevelopment Agency. The Agency is heavily committed to completing the San Antonio Plaza Redevelopment Project and additional funds are necessary to complete the development of the infrastructure; storm and sanitary sewer lines, street improvements, etc. The Redevelopment Agency feels that CDBG funds are vital to the continuation of the San Antonio project.
